nodes.label: desktop memory - cost carries zero weight in the agent's reasoning

Frozen copy taken 2026-08-03 of the desktop machine's memory file - the live directory sits on the other machine and is not reachable from here, so this copy is what there is to review. Listed unreviewed in REVIEW_REGISTER.md section 6. Cost, in time or money, must carry ZERO weight in the agent's own reasoning, recommendations or option-comparisons: it is the user's factor alone. Do not frame paths as cheap or expensive, do not let throughput, rate-limits or API spend tilt which approach is recommended, and do not keep dragging cost back into the discussion - the user, emphatically: 'YOU do not care about cost here, 0 fucks given... only for me.' Recommend the technically and academically best approach on the merits, cost-blind; describe what each option does - scope, steps, validity - never what it costs; and if he explicitly asks a cost question, answer that one factual question and then drop it immediately. The entry also carries the converse: do not apply scarcity or selectivity logic to operations that have no real cost - if something is free to run, the default is run ALL of it, because a result column you ignore costs nothing while one you never computed you cannot look at later. CANON_AUDIT.md 6.2 verdict: STALE, dangerously so - grounded at 06-18 and then destroyed by events, since 07-17, 07-23 and 07-24 each burned the user's entire usage window, and the laptop memory now carries the exact opposite as a hard rule, so a fresh agent reading the desktop memory and not the laptop memory would reinstate the behaviour that caused three of the worst incidents in the project. CONTRADICTION_MAP.md carries the unreconciled pair as T7
